interest: Gives 1932 Japanese cement industry capital, output, and trade figures.
overview: Telegram No. 107 (1932) reports Japan's cement industry: 200 million yen capital, 3.7 million tons annual output, exports 450,000 tons.

people.name: Edwin L. Neville
people.role: U.S. Chargé d'Affaires ad interim in Tokyo

subfiles.about: Telegram conveying Commercial Attaché data regarding capitalization, output, and foreign trade in the Japanese cement industry.
subfiles.summary: Telegram No. 107 from Neville forwards Commercial Attaché data on Japan's cement industry: about 200,000,000 yen capital, average annual output of 3,700,000 tons, exports of 450,000 tons, imports of 10,000 tons; industry deemed fundamentally sound despite unsatisfactory conditions.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 107 from Neville (Tokyo) on the Japanese Cement Industry
